Open the local web UI for editing the project in forms instead of YAML (functions, triggers, workflows, resources, on-prem drivers, provider options, code) and running validate / deploy / invoke. It doesn't take the common project options. It prints `http://127.0.0.1:8770/#token=...`. The token is required on every API call, so open that exact URL. See [studio.md](studio.md).

`--dir` (short flag `-d`) sets the project root. The default is `.`. `--port` still binds, and the default port is 8770. The help example sets both. The UI does not take the common project options, and you must open the printed token URL. [docs/cli.md#pskit-studio]

**In the terminal**
1. Set root and port together.

```
pskit studio -d path/to/project --port 8800
```
